note: Ukraine from February 2022 (Russian full-scale invasion on 24 February 2022). UCDP Georeferenced Event Dataset: events of organised violence (state-based conflict, non-state conflict and one-sided violence against civilians) that caused at least one death, in Ukraine, 2022-02 to 2026-08. Sources: UCDP GED Global 26.1 (to December 2025) plus UCDP Candidate monthly releases for 2026 (26.01.26.06, 26.0.7, 26.0.8; last month covered 2026-08). Candidate events are preliminary and may be revised or removed in the next GED release, and are less complete than the annual GED. 37424 events (GED 26.1: 35302, Candidate 26.01.26.06: 1505, Candidate 26.0.7: 322, Candidate 26.0.8: 295; state-based 37178, one-sided 246), best-estimate deaths 190,473. Events are placed at their coded location (often a town or a province centroid when the exact place is unknown); 1570 of 38994 events coded only to country level or to international waters/airspace are left out. Only events UCDP codes to country 'Ukraine' are included. Month is the event's start date. Cells are grid squares; lon/lat give the cell centre. Cell size 0.25 deg. Values are UCDP's best estimate of deaths (combatants and civilians), which is uncertain; UCDP also gives low and high estimates.
vUnits: UCDP best-estimate deaths per cell and month
